newsitem.title: UK: BP/Statoil plan resuming Nigeria drilling mid-1998.
newsitem.headline: BP/Statoil plan resuming Nigeria drilling mid-1998.

text.p: British Petroleum Plc and Norway's Statoil plan to resume exploration drilling in deep waters offshore Nigeria in the middle of next year despite modest results from an initial five-well programme, BP said on Wednesday.
Results from five wells in water depths of 500-800 metres had proved "modest, but they do not alter our plans to fully explore the deeper water prospects in the acreage," a BP spokesman said.
Three discoveries were made but none were considered commercial under current circumstances, the spokesman said.
The BP-Statoil alliance, working in Nigeria since 1992, expected to move into deeper waters, possibly to 1,500 metres, for the next phase of their programme.
Drilling staff are being returned from Nigeria after a 3-D seismic survey covering 2,600 square kilometres which must now be evaluated.
Statoil is operator of the exploration license interests in Nigeria which constitute four offshore blocks.
